title: OCO index: day H with hour T / S / N and place 1-3
prompt: Legend: H = 'Cotidie Hebd. I-IV Psalterii' (every day). Nine rows give Terce, Sext and None three antiphons each (1-3), e.g. the complementary psalmody pp699-701. Today TERCE/SEXT/NONE have only one part 'ant'; MIDDAY has ant1-3 (your ruling: hora media = MIDDAY). 9 index row(s). Examples: #485 'Adiutorium nostrum' H|S|2 p637; #641 'Auxilium meum' H|T|2 p623; #681 'Beati omnes' H|N|3 p674; #763 'Benefac Domine' H|S|3 p700; #825 'Clamavi' H|T|1 p664; #1477 'Facti sumus' H|N|1 p645. Legend OCO pp1210-1213 does not define this code. Rows with it are held: the mapper (oco/oco_sigla.py) gives no lit_part_sources target, so identity can load but the assignment waits. Answer = what the code means and where the chant goes (service.part, epoch, option_txt). Carry-out: add the rule to oco_sigla.py, re-run oco/load_oco_lps.py, record it in oco/specs/README.md 'User rulings'.
